prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good starting point is **World Martial Arts Academy**, at **1057 Cave Springs Blvd**. It offers age-specific classes for preschoolers (ages 4–5) and kids (ages 6–10), with an emphasis on confidence, focus, discipline, and self-defense. Its site advertises a **14-day trial for $49** and lists tuition at **$159/month**; confirm current pricing and class times before visiting. [Website](https://blackbeltstl.com/)

A couple of other options, depending on what your child wants:

- **ATA Martial Arts – St. Peters**, **6720 Mexico Rd**: Taekwondo-style classes for ages 4–6 and 7–12; advertises a six-week introductory offer for $69. [Classes and details](https://www.atastpeters.com/our-classes)
- **Onyx Grappling**, **953 Jungermann Rd**: Brazilian jiu-jitsu for children, with age-grouped classes and a free introductory class advertised. [Kids’ program](https://onyxgrappling.com/martial-arts-for-kids-near-me/)

I’d try a class at one or two schools and see how your child responds to the instructor and class atmosphere. Ask about instructor experience with kids, how they handle sparring and safety, and whether the trial requires a longer-term commitment.
